title: Austin Mobility: Equity, Tech, Airport Access
summary:
*   **Emerging Transportation Tech:** Discussed new mobility technologies with industry experts shaping the future of transit.
*   **Racial Equity & Project Connect:** Briefing on a tool designed to prevent resident displacement caused by the Project Connect transit expansion.
*   **Airport Accessibility (ADA):** Received an update on efforts to improve mobility and accessibility for people with disabilities at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.
